Query:
UNLOAD (SELECT bs."in.comstock_building_type" AS comstock_building_type, sum(1) AS metadata_rows_count, count(distinct(bs.bldg_id)) AS model_count, sum(bs.weight) AS units_count, sum(bs."out.natural_gas.total.energy_consumption..kwh" * bs.weight) AS "natural_gas.total.energy_consumption..kwh", sum(CASE WHEN (coalesce(bs."out.natural_gas.total.energy_consumption..kwh", 0) != 0) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END * bs.weight) AS "natural_gas.total.energy_consumption..kwh__nonzero_units_count" FROM comstock_amy2018_r2_2025_md_by_state_and_county_parquet AS bs WHERE bs.applicability = true AND bs.upgrade = 0 AND bs.state = 'CO' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1) 
 TO 's3://resstock-core/bsq_athena_unload_results/9e4d4a57e17f4e458c3c82d546ae394ac304329a5fe1b13de5f1b7e1d1307afc/8580497c-2093-4de0-bac7-83278b772a8b/' 
 WITH (format = 'PARQUET')
